messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: metering-emitter anomaly (PD-4821) - sudden divergence between emitter and aggregator token counts. Spike started ~2024-12-12T02:08Z. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/MTG/metering-overview :rotating_light:

sara.k: Oncall here, grabbing this. Which metric is diverging? Emitter vs aggregator? Any customer-facing alerts?

raj.p: Quick readout: aggregator (token_agg_hourly) shows ~+12-15% vs emitter (emitter_hourly) for two consecutive 5m windows. Sample query I ran:
```
SELECT hour, emitter_count, agg_count, agg_count - emitter_count AS delta
FROM metering.hourly_agg
WHERE hour >= '2024-12-12T01:50Z' AND hour <= '2024-12-12T02:20Z'
ORDER BY hour;
```
Sample row: hour=2024-12-12T02:05Z emitter=1,234,567 agg=1,423,890 delta=189,323

olivia: CS saying some customers got overage emails around 02:10 UTC. cs-ops, any screenshots?

cs-ops: We have 3 customer complaints so far (acct ids masked): C-1023, C-4480, C-7721. All received automated overage notices between 02:09-02:14 UTC. No paid refunds yet.

mike.oncall: Taking handoff from @sara.k. I'll mute outgoing billing alerts while we investigate so we don't spam customers. Going to run `scripts/disable-overage-propagation --ephemeral` now.

incident-bot: Action logged: disable-overage-propagation requested by mike.oncall at 2024-12-12T02:18Z. PD incident updated.

raj.p: Early hypothesis: delayed emitter ack + exponential retry created duplicate emit events at the ingestion layer, which aggregator dedup logic didn't catch due to missing request_id header on retry. Looking into emitter logs now. Grepping for request_id patterns: `grep -E \"request_id|retry_id\" /var/log/emitter/*.log | tail -n 200`

billing-eng: Confirming logs show retry pattern. Example log snippet:
```
[2024-12-12T02:06:11Z] emitter INFO id=null retry=1 payload_size=2487
[2024-12-12T02:06:41Z] emitter INFO id=abc123 retry=2 payload_size=2487
```
We lost request_id on first attempt (id=null) so aggregator treated the second as a new event.

olivia: Is this a regression from the deploy last night? Any config changes to the emitter HTTP client?

raj.p: There was a libcurl upgrade in the emitter image at 2024-12-12T00:42Z. Correlating that with first sightings. Also seeing increased emitter latency (p95 4.8s -> 12.1s) which drives retries.

mike.oncall: Mitigation plan: 1) Keep propagation muted. 2) Patch emitter to force id on retry path (hotfix PR coming). 3) Start backfill dedupe job to remove duplicated tokens for windows 02:00-02:20 UTC. 4) Notify CS for affected accounts and pause billing actions. I'll take steps 1 and 3 now.

cs-ops: Thanks. We've drafted customer comms. Estimated affected customers: 12 accounts in total, highest single account delta ~+48k tokens (~$120 overage). Aggregate potential overcharge estimated <$1.5k.

billing-eng: Backfill job kicked: `scripts/backfill-dedupe --start 2024-12-12T02:00Z --end 2024-12-12T02:20Z --dry-run=false` Started at 02:23Z; ETA ~6m. Will emit summary when done.

raj.p: Quick checklist for postmortem items: - revert libcurl or pin version - add request_id enforcement in emitter middleware - improve dedupe keys in aggregator - add alert for emitter-retry-rate > 1%

mike.oncall: Backfill finished at 02:29Z. Stats: scanned 1.1M token events, deduped 172,900 tokens (~0.9% of scanned). No billing writes performed while propagation muted. 

incident-bot: Backfill job completed, run_id=bf-20241212-02-23, deduped=172900.

olivia: CS note: we've paused automated billing actions and will proactively reach out to the 12 customers with a heads-up and credit plan. Send me final dedupe numbers to include.

mike.oncall: Hotfix PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/emitter/pull/482 - adds `request_id` preservation on retries + pins curl to 7.86. Waiting for 1 approver. Rolling to a small canary (2 pods) after merge.

billing-eng: Canary deployed at 02:41Z to eu-west-1 (2 pods). Initial metrics look good: emitter p95 down to 3.1s, retry-rate back to baseline 0.2%. No new overage alerts triggered.

raj.p: Monitoring panels updated, will keep watch for 30m. Next update +15m or on any regression.

mike.oncall: Taking this to postmortem. Assigning lead: @raj.p, slas: document customer impact and mitigation timeline. I'll stay on until 03:30Z for handoff. :thumbsup:
